question.problem:
Solve the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}3.6v+21.6=0 \\ 3v+4w+2=0\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
To get rid of the decimals, we multiply the top equation by $10,$ as follows:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}3.6v+21.6=0 & |\,\times 10 \\ 3v+4w+2=0 & \end{aligned}\,⟹\,\{\begin{aligned}36v+216=0 \\ 3v+4w+2=0\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that we can easily solve for $v$ in the first equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}36v+216 & =0 \\ 36v & =-216 \\ v & =-6\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to find the value of $w,$ we can substitute $v=-6$ into the second equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}3v+4w+2 & =0 \\ 3(-6)+4w+2 & =0 \\ -18+4w+2 & =0 \\ 4w & =16 \\ w & =4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $v=-6,\,w=4.$
